subject: Eye
text: The Eye has 162 HP, yields 3225 Gold and 3225 Exp, and attacks with instant-death spells including Rub, Stone, and XXXX.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 162...Gold: 3225...Exp.: 3225...A very serious opponent, the Eye is very big on one-hit kills (Rub, Stone,
XXXX).

subject: Eye
text: The Eye has weak defense against weapon attacks, and casting Mute stops its spells completely.

evidence.quote:
However, with a weak defense, weapons can cut this evil entity down
quickly.  As for Magic, hard hitting magic spells are a gamble, Mute is a
great move (stop the spells, no danger from his enemy).

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Opening the treasure chest after defeating the Eye yields the FLOATER.

evidence.quote: After defeating this enemy, open the Treasure Chest to find the FLOATER!

subject: ProRing
text: Equipping the entire party with ProRings protects against Rub and XXXX when fighting the Eye to farm Experience and Gold.

evidence.quote:
Also note
that the Eye is a great place to come to when you your entire party is
equipped with ProRings, which protects against spells like Rub and XXXX, so
your Experience and Gold totals can quickly be rolled up in a short amount
of time.

subject: Ice Cave
text: To exit the Ice Cave, head down across damaging floors, take the right fork through a narrow rock space to a staircase, enter and exit the room, and follow the path up and right to the surface stairway.

evidence.quote:
To leave this Cave, you will have to duel the Undead posses again, head down
over the damaging floor and bearing right, followed by continuing down past
the two branches to go through a narrow rock space.  Take the right fork and
follow it to a staircase.  After entering and then exiting the room, go
right and then up and right around the room to find a stairway leading to
the surface!

subject: Airship
text: Using the FLOATER inside the desert east of the river mouth causes the Airship to rise from the sand.

evidence.quote:
Land on the river mouth, hike into the desert, and use your FLOATER
to make the Airship rise magically from its hiding place in the sand!

subject: Treasure Chests
object: 2750 Gold Pieces, 2000 Gold Pieces, 1455 Gold Pieces, 160 Gold Pieces, 9500 Gold Pieces, 1520 Gold Pieces, and 2750 Gold Pieces
text: The forested island southwest of the Castle of Ordeals contains two rooms with treasure chests holding 2750 Gold Pieces, 2000 Gold Pieces, 1455 Gold Pieces, 160 Gold Pieces, 9500 Gold Pieces, 1520 Gold Pieces, and 2750 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Start off by finding the Castle Of Ordeals (it is to the east of the
islands), go southwest to find an island with forest surrounding it to enter
to find 2750 Gold Pieces, 2000 Gold Pieces, 1455 Gold Pieces, 160 Gold
Pieces, 9500 Gold Pieces, 1520 Gold Pieces, and 2750 Gold Pieces in the two
rooms with the Treasure Chests.

subject: Treasure Chests
object: House, 500 Gold Pieces, and 10 Gold Pieces
text: The cave on the marshy island west of the forested island contains treasure chests with a House, 500 Gold Pieces, and 10 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Take off again and fly west to land on the
marshy island and walk into the cave there to find the following goodies
from Treasure Chests: House, 500 Gold Pieces, and 10 Gold Pieces.

subject: Treasure Chests
object: Cabin, 575 Gold Pieces, and a Soft Potion
text: The northwest island cave contains treasure chests with a Cabin, 575 Gold Pieces, and a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote:
Now head
northwest to find a single cave with some Treasure Chests: Cabin, 575 Gold
Pieces, and a Soft Potion.

subject: Bahamut
text: Presenting the TAIL to Bahamut in his cave on the eastern island grants the party a CLASS CHANGE.

evidence.quote:
Now you should head east, landing the Airship on
southern tip of the island and enter the nearby cave to go through the long
passageways to find Bahamut, King of Dragons.  He rewards courage, and since
we already grabbed the TAIL, you have proof of courage, thus your courage
will be rewarded by your characters receiving a CLASS CHANGE!

subject: Gaia
text: Gaia is located in an enclosed valley northeast of the large northern desert.

evidence.quote:
Upon taking off, head east until you find a large desert, at which
point you should head for the northeast corner of it and continue northeast
to find Gaia in an enclosed valley (land and enter).

subject: Cat Claw
text: The Cat Claw is sold for 65000 Gold at the Gaia Weapon Shop, providing 22 Damage and 35 Hit% for Knight, Ninja, Red Wizard, and Black Wizard.

subject: Gold Bracelet
text: The Gold Bracelet is sold for 50000 Gold at the Gaia Armor Shop, providing 34 Absorb and 1 Evade% for all classes.

subject: Brak

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: The Gurgu Volcano is situated northwest of Crescent Lake and east of Elfland.

evidence.quote:
Regardless, find the Gurgu Volcano (northwest of Crescent Lake,
east of Elfland), use a tent to save just outside of it, and then head into
the fiery depths below!

subject: Fire
text: The Fire enemy has 276 HP, drops 800 Gold and 1620 Exp, and is vulnerable to Ice2 and Ice3 spells.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 276...Gold: 800...Exp.: 1620...have your Red
Wizard or Black Wizard attack with Ice2 or Ice3, and have your White Wizard
or Red Wizard perform healing duties as needed.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: A treasure chest on the second floor of Gurgu Volcano contains the Giant Sword.

evidence.quote:
Open the Treasure Chest for the Giant Sword contained within, then retrace
your steps back to the upwards passage and follow it to find a Treasure
Chest with 4150 Gold Pieces inside of it.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: A treasure chest along the upwards passage on the second floor of Gurgu Volcano contains 4150 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
retrace
your steps back to the upwards passage and follow it to find a Treasure
Chest with 4150 Gold Pieces inside of it.

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Two treasure chests guarded by Fire enemies on the second floor contain 750 Gold Pieces and 795 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Now head up, then left to take
the second passage leading down to get to two Treasure Chests (guarded by a
Fire set) to get 750 Gold Pieces and 795 Gold Pieces.

subject: Treasure Chests
text: The first two treasure chests entered from the left square of the entrance hold a Silver Gauntlet and a Silver Helmet.

evidence.quote:
Walk into the room on the left square of the
three square-wide entrance (avoids a Fire fight) to open the first two
Treasure Chests to get a Silver Gauntlet and a Silver Helmet.

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Two treasure chests below the armor chests contain a Heal Potion and a Cabin.

evidence.quote:
Next, go down
to get the Heal Potion and the Cabin from the two Treasure Chests below

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Moving right reveals treasure chests containing 1975 Gold Pieces and 1455 Gold Pieces guarded by a Grey Worm.

evidence.quote:
followed by moving right to get 1975 Gold Pieces and then into a fight with
a Grey Worm (weak to Ice attacks) for 1455 Gold Pieces.

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Treasure chests in the multi-chest room yield a Pure Potion from below and 1520 Gold Pieces from above.

evidence.quote:
Now grab the Pure
Potion from below, the 1520 Gold Pieces from above, and then go to the right
side of the Treasure Chest stack to grab 1760 Gold Pieces, Silver Shield,
Silver Axe, and a Heal Potion.

subject: Treasure Chests
object: 1760 Gold Pieces, Silver Shield, Silver Axe, and Heal Potion
text: The right side of the treasure chest stack contains 1760 Gold Pieces, a Silver Shield, a Silver Axe, and a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote:
go to the right
side of the Treasure Chest stack to grab 1760 Gold Pieces, Silver Shield,
Silver Axe, and a Heal Potion.

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Opening the right chest from below in the room avoids a Grey Worm and yields a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote:
Go left and then up through the door, cutting right to open the Treasure
Chest on the right (avoids a grey Worm fight) from below for a Soft Potion,
followed by opening the Treasure Chest on the left (avoids an Agama fight)
from the side.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: A room across the lava floor contains a treasure chest with 1760 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Exit the room and resume heading left and then down across
the damaging lava floor to find another room to enter.  Inside is 1760 Gold
Pieces in a Treasure Chest

subject: Treasure Chests
object: Pure Potion, 7340 Gold Pieces, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, and 880 Gold Pieces
text: The room along the corridor contains chests holding a Pure Potion, 7340 Gold Pieces, a Flame Shield guarded by a Grey Worm, an Ice Sword, and 880 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Open the Treasure Chest near the
door for a Pure Potion, then the Treasure Chest directly above for 7340 Gold
Pieces, and then go right and up to fight a Grey Worm (weak to Ice) to open
the Treasure Chest to the right for a Flame Shield.  Now open the remaining
two Treasure Chests (Ice Sword and 880 Gold Pieces)

subject: Treasure Chests
text: Two treasure chests guarded by Agamas contain 1250 Gold Pieces and a Wooden Staff.

evidence.quote:
Open the two Treasure Chests (fighting Agamas) for 1250
Gold Pieces and a Wooden Staff (SUCH ADVANCED WEAPONRY!) before exiting the
room to head down to find the stairway leading downwards.

subject: Red Dragon
text: The Red Dragon has 248 HP, awards 4000 Gold and 2904 Exp, and uses Blaze to deal up to 300 HP damage to all party members.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 248...Gold: 4000...Exp.: 2904...He
can use his special attack of Blaze (Fir3 is the equivalent) to damage each
party member for up to 300 Hit Points each, AND he can also attack with
ferocity (often inflicting 100 Hit Points or more damage).

subject: Red Dragon
text: The Red Dragon is vulnerable to Ice magic, or Fir3 and Lit3 if Ice spell charges are depleted.

evidence.quote:
This beast is
vulnerable to Ice, but you may have run out of charges for it by now, so use
Fir3 or Lit3 from a Black Wizard instead.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Defeating the Red Dragon and Agama in the side room allows the party to claim the Flame Armor.

evidence.quote:
Now take the Flame Armor, fight the Agama again, and then exit the room to
head downwards to find a branch going down left that leads to a room where
your party should pause as they enter to refill their Hit Points.
